For \(n=1\), \(2S_1=a_2a_1\Rightarrow 2=a_2\), so \(S_2=3\).

For \(n\ge2\), substitute \(a_n=S_n-S_{n-1}\), \(a_{n+1}=S_{n+1}-S_n\):
\[
(S_{n+1}-S_n)(S_n-S_{n-1})=2S_n.
\]
The initial values are \(S_1=1,\ S_2=3\). The sequence
\[
S_n=\frac{n(n+1)}2
\]
satisfies
\[
(S_{n+1}-S_n)(S_n-S_{n-1})=(n+1)n=2S_n.
\]
Thus \(S_{20}=\frac{20\cdot21}{2}=210\).

\[
\boxed{210}
\]
